title: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 joins the video models
summary:
Three models landed for video, images, and multimodal text work, while catalog and permission housekeeping kept the garden in order.

Added `grok-imagine-video-1.5` for video generation from text or a start image, with synchronized audio and a choice of 480p, 720p, or 1080p. The existing `grok-video-pro` route is unchanged.

Added Krea 2 Medium under `krea`, with `krea-2` as an alias. The text-to-image model accepts seeds and supported aspect ratios; it does not accept image references.

Added `qwen3.8-max` alongside the unchanged `qwen3.7-max`. It accepts text, images, and video, supports tools and reasoning, and has a 1-million-token context window.
